issues: Partial: despite its title the PDF covers only Semester II of 2025-26 (created 2026-02-13). It has a block schedule grid plus full descriptions (driving questions, 'GX' graduate-expectation tags) for ~10 interdisciplinary 'Studio' courses (e.g. American Military History, Chemistry of Color, Survival, Algebra II, American Horror Story, World Religions & Belief, A Bridge Too Far, Interpretations!). Block courses (AP Biology, AP Composition, PE/Health, Spanish, Business Algebra I, art/music/design studios, Crew) appear only as titles in the schedule. No Semester I or 2026-27 catalog found, even though the 2026-27 year is underway as of check date; the site still links the 2025-26 file. Studio offerings appear to rotate by semester, so the catalog is a semester offering list, not a stable program of studies. The Graduation Handbook (Google Doc) may hold graduation requirements but needs sign-in. Note: the district is weighing closing Cabot HS in 2027/28 (see cabot-school-options page). A 2015 legislature testimony PDF on Cabot academics turned up in search but is outdated.
